deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'case "${SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9]*) echo "Refusing to start: SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD must be letters and digits." >&2; exit 64;; esac; if [ "${#SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD}" -lt 24 ]; then echo "Refusing to start: SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD must have at least 24 characters." >&2; exit 64; fi; mkdir -p /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d; printf "CREATE ROLE spicedb LOGIN PASSWORD \$spicedb\$%s\$spicedb\$;\nCREATE DATABASE spicedb OWNER spicedb;\n" "$SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD" > /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-spicedb.sql; chown postgres:postgres /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-spicedb.sql; chmod 0600 /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-spicedb.sql; exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres'

SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Generated password of the spicedb role, created with its database when the volume is first initialized.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'until wget -q -O /dev/null "$FORMBRICKS_READY_URL"; do echo "Waiting for Formbricks migrations"; sleep 3; done; GOOSE_DRIVER=postgres GOOSE_DBSTRING="$DATABASE_URL" /usr/local/bin/goose -dir /app/migrations up; PGUSER=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[a-z]+://([^:@/]+):.*#\1#") PGPASSWORD=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[a-z]+://[^:@/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#") PGHOST=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[^@]+@([^:/?]+).*#\1#") PGPORT=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[^@]+@[^:/?]+:([0-9]+).*#\1#") PGDATABASE=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[^@]+@[^/]+/([^?]+).*#\1#") PGSSLMODE=disable /usr/local/bin/river migrate-up; exec /app/hub-api'

API_KEY.description: Generated API key Formbricks uses to call Hub.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection string; Hub shares the formbricks database.

FORMBRICKS_READY_URL.description: Private Formbricks readiness URL. Hub waits for Formbricks' migrations before running its own.

PORT.description: Hub API listener; Railway's health check calls /health on it.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'until wget -q -O /dev/null "$HUB_HEALTH_URL"; do echo "Waiting for the Hub API"; sleep 3; done; exec /app/hub-worker'

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection string; the worker reads Hub's job queue.

HUB_HEALTH_URL.description: Private Hub health URL. The worker waits for Hub's migrations before starting.

CUBEJS_API_SECRET.description: Generated secret that Cube uses to verify Formbricks' query tokens.

CUBEJS_CACHE_AND_QUEUE_DRIVER.description: In-memory cache and queue; keep Cube at one replica.

CUBEJS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.description: No external pre-aggregations, so Cube Store is not needed.

CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience of Formbricks' query tokens.

CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER.description: Expected issuer of Formbricks' query tokens.

PORT.description: Cube API listener; Railway's health check calls /readyz on it.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'owner=$(printf "%s" "${FORMBRICKS_OWNER_EMAIL:-}" | tr -d " \t\r" | tr "A-Z" "a-z"); case "$owner" in ""|*[!a-z0-9._%+@-]*) echo "Refusing to start: set FORMBRICKS_OWNER_EMAIL to the email address of the first administrator." >&2; exit 64;; esac; if ! printf "%s" "$owner" | grep -Eq "^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9-]+([.][a-z0-9-]+)*[.][a-z]{2,}$"; then echo "Refusing to start: FORMBRICKS_OWNER_EMAIL is not a plain email address." >&2; exit 64; fi; case "${FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9]*) echo "Refusing to start: FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD must be letters and digits." >&2; exit 64;; esac; case "$FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD" in *[A-Z]*) ;; *) echo "Refusing to start: FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD needs a capital letter." >&2; exit 64;; esac; case "$FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD" in *[0-9]*) ;; *) echo "Refusing to start: FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD needs a digit." >&2; exit 64;; esac; if [ "${#FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ] || [ "${#FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD}" -gt 128 ]; then echo "Refusing to start: FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD must have 16 to 128 characters." >&2; exit 64; fi; export NODE_ENV=production; node /home/nextjs/validate-env.mjs --server; db_host=$(printf "%s" "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#^[a-z]+://[^@]*@([^:/?]+).*#\1#"); until nc -z -w 3 "$db_host" 5432; do echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL"; sleep 2; done; timeout 300 node packages/database/dist/scripts/apply-migrations.js; timeout 60 node packages/database/dist/scripts/create-saml-database.js; n=0; until formbricks-authzed upgrade prepare; do n=$((n + 1)); if [ "$n" -ge 60 ]; then echo "Formbricks could not prepare SpiceDB." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for SpiceDB"; sleep 5; done; printf "%s" "" | base64 -d > /tmp/formbricks-guard.cjs; state=$(node /tmp/formbricks-guard.cjs pre "$owner"); HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 env -u FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD node apps/web/online-server.js & pid=$!; trap "kill -TERM $pid 2>/dev/null; exit 143" TERM INT; until wget -q -O /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health/ready"; do if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Formbricks exited during the provisioning boot." >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; umask 077; [ "$state" != fresh ] || action=$(node -e "const [file, name, source] = process.argv.slice(1); const actions = require(file).node; const ids = Object.keys(actions).filter((id) => actions[id].exportedName === name && actions[id].filename === source); if (ids.length !== 1) process.exit(1); console.log(ids[0]);" /home/nextjs/apps/web/.next/server/server-reference-manifest.json createUserAction apps/web/modules/auth/signup/actions.ts); [ "$state" != fresh ] || printf "[{\"name\":\"Owner\",\"email\":\"%s\",\"password\":\"%s\"}]" "$owner" "$FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD" > /tmp/formbricks-owner.json; [ "$state" != fresh ] || wget -q -O /tmp/formbricks-owner.out --header "Next-Action: $action" --header "Accept: text/x-component" --header "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --header "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}" --post-file /tmp/formbricks-owner.json "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/setup/signup" || true; rm -f /tmp/formbricks-owner.json; [ "$state" != fresh ] || grep -q "\"data\":{\"success\":true}" /tmp/formbricks-owner.out 2>/dev/null || { echo "Owner bootstrap failed; stopping." >&2; kill -TERM "$pid"; wait "$pid" || true; exit 1; }; rm -f /tmp/formbricks-owner.out; [ "$state" != fresh ] || printf "{\"email\":\"%s\",\"password\":\"%s\"}" "$owner" "$FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD" > /tmp/formbricks-signin.json; [ "$state" != fresh ] || wget -q -O /dev/null --header "Content-Type: application/json" --post-file /tmp/formbricks-signin.json "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/auth/sign-in/email" || { rm -f /tmp/formbricks-signin.json; echo "The new owner account cannot sign in; stopping." >&2; kill -TERM "$pid"; wait "$pid" || true; exit 1; }; rm -f /tmp/formbricks-signin.json; node /tmp/formbricks-guard.cjs post; [ "$state" = fresh ] && echo "Created the Formbricks owner account for $owner." || echo "Formbricks already has an owner account."; kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" || true; trap - TERM INT; exec env -u FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD node apps/web/online-server.js'

AUTHZED_CONSISTENCY.description: SpiceDB consistency mode for permission checks.

AUTHZED_INSECURE.description: Plaintext gRPC to SpiceDB over Railway's private network.

AUTHZED_SYSTEM_KEY.description: Name of the Formbricks system object in SpiceDB.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generated secret that signs sessions and invite, verification and email-change tokens.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Public Formbricks URL used for authentication and cookies. Keep it equal to WEBAPP_URL.

CRON_SECRET.description: Generated secret for Formbricks' cron API.

CUBEJS_API_SECRET.description: Secret Formbricks signs Cube query tokens with; shared with the Cube service.

CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Audience claim of Cube query tokens; must match the Cube service.

CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER.description: Issuer claim of Cube query tokens; must match the Cube service.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection string for the formbricks database.

EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DISABLED.description: No email provider is configured. Set to 0 after adding SMTP variables.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated key for two-factor secrets and single-use survey links. Do not change it after first use.

FORMBRICKS_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Required. Your email address. Formbricks creates the owner account for it before its public listener opens, and refuses to start while it is empty.

FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Generated password of the owner account created at first start. Sign in with it and keep it in a password manager; password reset needs email.

HOSTNAME.description: Listen on IPv4 and IPv6 so Railway private networking reaches Formbricks.

HUB_API_KEY.description: API key of the private Formbricks Hub service.

PASSWORD_RESET_DISABLED.description: No email provider is configured. Set to 0 after adding SMTP variables.

PORT.description: Formbricks listener; Railway's health check calls /health/ready on it.

REDIS_URL.description: Private password-protected Valkey for sessions, rate limits and the background job queue.

TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Turns off Formbricks' anonymous usage telemetry.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOP_COUNT.description: X-Forwarded-For hops Formbricks trusts for the client IP behind Railway's edge; rate limits use it.

WEBAPP_URL.description: Public Formbricks URL used in links and survey pages. Change it with BETTER_AUTH_URL if you add a custom domain.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'n=0; until spicedb datastore migrate head; do n=$((n + 1)); if [ "$n" -ge 60 ]; then echo "SpiceDB could not migrate its datastore." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL"; sleep 5; done; exec spicedb serve --telemetry-endpoint=""'

PORT.description: SpiceDB HTTP listener; Railway's health check calls /healthz on it. gRPC stays on 50051.

SPICEDB_DATASTORE_CONN_POOL_READ_MAX_OPE.description: Read connection pool cap, sized for one small PostgreSQL.

SPICEDB_DATASTORE_CONN_URI.description: Private connection string for SpiceDB's own role and database.

SPICEDB_GRPC_PRESHARED_KEY.description: Generated key that Formbricks presents to SpiceDB.

SPICEDB_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enables SpiceDB's HTTP listener for the health check.

SPICEDB_LOG_LEVEL.description: Warnings and errors only; info logs every gRPC call.

SPICEDB_SKIP_RELEASE_CHECK.description: Skips SpiceDB's check for newer releases at start.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -ec 'case "${VALKEY_PASSWORD:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9]*) echo "Refusing to start: VALKEY_PASSWORD must be letters and digits." >&2; exit 64;; esac; umask 077; printf "requirepass %s\n" "$VALKEY_PASSWORD" > /tmp/valkey-railway.conf; chown valkey:valkey /tmp/valkey-railway.conf; cd /data; exec docker-entrypoint.sh /tmp/valkey-railway.conf --appendonly yes --maxmemory-policy noeviction'
